header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Rashid Ali Shah advocate for the private respondents
body: Mr. Dhani Bux, Assistant P.G = None is present on behalf of the appellant nor any intimation received. Same was the position on the last date of hearing which reflects that the appellant has lost his interest to proceed with this appeal.
Under these circumstances, this appeal is dismissed for nonprosecution.
